fixed_issue_groups.fix: Decode strings and embedded arguments; preserve model/session/conversation/tool identifiers, JSON schemas and opaque media while masking actual tool inputs, including same-named fields; support gzip and form decoding.
Restore tokens split at every character, including the first brace; flush literal text tails without dropping data.
Separate choices, tool call indices, Responses output/content indices and Anthropic content blocks; handle completion snapshots independently.
Buffer each tool argument document until its completion boundary, then restore JSON with proper escaping; reject unknown/incomplete tokens before completion is forwarded.
Handle multiline data events and CRLF; preserve exact JSON numbers; detect short writes and bound event/tool buffers.
Wrap unknown input token examples as literal mappings, preserve known tokens on repeated masking, and allow safe reproduction in source code.
Remove obsolete Content-Length/checksum headers; decode gzip and restore plain text; abort unreadable or over-limit responses without silent truncation.
Persist mappings before forwarding, checkpoint periodically and on shutdown, retain dirty state on save failure, serialize saves, preserve TTL timestamps and reject corrupt stores/keys.
Reject new mappings at capacity instead of evicting live tokens needed by in-flight responses; prevent suffix reuse.
Synchronize live configuration and rules, atomically save validated rules to the original config file, retain old live rules if saving fails.
Recognize sk- style keys, limit PEM matching to each individual block, and observe dangerous arguments in non-streaming responses.
